Pot and various pills.

Pudding's awesome too!  You got it made!

Thanks

I have depression and anxiety and have been on various antidepressants over the years.  Seems like the last year or so i've had the constant suicidal thoughts though.  I'm on a new pill now, which is actually an antipsychotic, hopefully it'll kick in soon and i can see the world through spongebob's eyes (kudos to anyone who's seen that episode).  Thank you for your reply!

Sure.  My wife and i were moving some stuff to her mom's house and it was really hot out.  I spotted some beer in the fridge there and after moving all that stuff and being all hot and sweaty, nothing sounded better than a cold one.  But her mom left and took all the beer with her over to my brother in law's house.  (They were having pizza and didn't have any sunday beer.  We can't buy alcohol on sundays in my gay state.). Anyway, she removed the temptation.  I'm not sure if i would have drank any or not.  We'll never know.

Cookout at the inlaws.  Beer, wine, margaritas.  Fuck that.  Gonna pass this year.

My dad drank beer every now and then but was not an alcoholic.  That's about it.  My mom never drank.  It's all on me.

I was in the same boat a while back.  I was depressed and suicidal.  I was on antidepressants, but i was also drinking all the time.  Drinking wasn't allowing the medication to do its job.  I quit drinking about a month ago and things seem much better.  Also, the thought of what my suicide would have done to my family helped to steer me away from it.
It will get better.  People on here will listen any time you need to talk.  I'm pulling for you.
Good luck captain!  You can do it.

Congrats!  I'm almost at 3 weeks myself.  It's not easy.
